_comment: The condensed page of every public Typst command, as Woodcore's commands tab and the website show it (calc/tools/command_pages.py, docs/typst/command-docs.md §10sexies; spec 2026-10-24-onglet-commandes-pages). Written by hand in French, German and English from the command's /// block and its translation in commands.json -- never derived by a script, never copied from a block. The signature, the defaults and the types are lib/'s and are not repeated here; tests/test_command_pages.py holds the two to the same names. A value's `call` is the Typst that shows what the value does, compiled once by calc/tools/build_examples.py into examples/out/values/; `setup` the lines it needs above it. An example's `context` is what it assumes above it: compiled with it by the tests, not shown. A value's `text` that is a string names its set in value-texts.

text.fr: Le niveau le plus bas auquel le contenu est imprimé : 1, 2 ou 3.
